instruction:
You are the final adversarial reviewer for a bounded public SDK workload-conformance slice. Use Fable 5.1 LOW. Static review only; no tools, execution, delegation or modifications. Return ACCEPT or REVISE, blockers with source locations, concrete false positives and smallest corrections, then optional findings. Do not infer validation you did not run.
Baseline d75aae9e. User-approved scope: mapped public source execution with partial failure, inspection of persisted tiers, and safe continuation decisions. The test parameterizes a downstream SourceError before versus after yielding one observation; a fresh non-forced invocation should skip a successful elapsed upstream and run the failed triggered downstream successfully. The after-yield case should explicitly retain repeated logical observations under distinct fact IDs. There is no resume-token API, automatic deduplication or exactly-once collection/dispatch guarantee. The test uses in-memory collectors; no external side effects are being tested. Existing engine/SDK tests separately cover unknown append, known-uncommitted, collection failure, projection and dispatch failures. No production change intended.
Assess causal specificity of source failure and success, exact durable tier/fact/lifecycle identities versus status strings, fresh per-tier/public read bases, lineage/head alignment, accurate deterministic timing and cadence evidence, correct skip/retry behavior and fresh identities across invocations, strict JSON evidence, isolated mapped fixtures, and documentation claim boundaries. Full prefix verification does not verify signatures/key trust/projected rows; explicit comparisons and existing mapped signing tests are complementary. Do not demand C9 retirement, generic retry APIs or unrelated scope expansion. Native logs are prior executed validation, not reviewer execution.
